title: Baofeng Lake - a mirror in the mountains
text: Baofeng (Precious Peak Lake) is a mountain lake inside a karst canyon where water so still reflects the surrounding cliffs perfectly. Just 5 minutes from the Wulingyuan gate, 96 yuan entrance includes a 30-minute boat ride with Tujia folk singers. Arrive early for best reflections.

title: Huanglong Cave - underground palace
text: Huanglong (Yellow Dragon Cave) is one of the largest karst caves in China, just 15 minutes from the Wulingyuan gate. Its 15 km extend over four levels and 13 halls, with a boat ride on an underground river. See the 19.2 m Sea-Stabilizing Stalagmite, insured for 100 million yuan.

title: First Bridge Under Heaven - natural wonder
text: Tianxia Diyiqiao is a natural stone bridge spanning two pillars 357 m above the valley - pure geology, no concrete. It is 20 m long, about 2 m wide and 4-5 m thick, formed when softer rock eroded away below. Come by 8 am to walk it before the crowds.

title: Yuanjiajie - the Avatar Mountains
text: Yuanjiajie is the plateau where the famous floating mountains are visible - the most visited section of the park. Reach it via Bailong Elevator (65 yuan) or the shuttle from Tianzi cable car. Key spots: Hallelujah Avatar Pillar, Back Garden, First Bridge Under Heaven.

title: Tianzi Mountain - the Emperor's Mountain
text: Tianzi Mountain at 1,262 m is the highest part of the park, named where a Tujia chief declared himself emperor. Reach it by cable car (72 yuan, 10 min) or on foot via 8,000 steps. Highlights: Imperial Brush pillar (on the 100-yuan note!), Helong Park and Western Sea.
